summary: Pre-deploy regression + security fixes verification for Miracurl (BUILD 2026-09-18.279). Backend: ran test_iter172_whatsapp_official.py + test_iter173_wa_receptionist.py (26+9 = 35 tests) and a new test_iter174_predeploy_smoke.py (9 tests). 33/35 iter172+173 pass + 9/9 iter174 pass = 42/44 total (95%). The 2 failures in iter173 are pre-existing LLM/slot-availability flakes (test_sim_salon_booking_flow, test_sim_restaurant_reservation_flow) — Mira correctly replies 'That time slot is fully booked' because prior test runs already booked the tomorrow-8pm slot; NOT a regression. Frontend smoke passes for salon admin (dashboard KPI tiles, appointments, CRM w/ WhatsApp Campaign toggle, POS, Settings PIN unlock + WhatsAppLinkCard with sender '+91 91802 61256' and 347 credits, Receptionist page with all 3 testids), restaurant admin (dashboard, kitchen, pos, receptionist w/ 'Needs WhatsApp credits' badge), and super admin (HQ Credit Wallet inside Billing & Subscriptions shows SMS 0 + WhatsApp 5000; Deployments panel shows 'MIRA-DEPLOYED-2026-09-18 · build 2026-09-18.279' with Mira Receptionist + Credit wallet release notes). No 500s or tracebacks in backend logs — only the expected Meta 400s ('account is not registered', code 133010) because the WABA number is currently deregistered.

minor.issue: Flake: test_sim_restaurant_reservation_flow + test_sim_salon_booking_flow fail intermittently once tomorrow's 8pm slot has been booked by earlier runs — Mira correctly replies 'time slot fully booked, please pick another'. Not a bug; needs test seed cleanup or a rolling target time in the test.

issues: React DOM warning: 'In HTML, <span> cannot be a child of <option> — will cause a hydration error.' Non-blocking but noisy in console; likely inside a native <select> where a Lucide icon <span> is placed inside an <option>.

action_items: OPTIONAL: harden the two flaky iter173 reservation tests by (a) using a slot >72h out and unique phone, or (b) clearing the day's bookings for the target guest before the flow. Not a deploy blocker.
OPTIONAL: clean up the '<span> inside <option>' React hydration warning (search JSX for <option> with a nested Lucide icon).
critical_code_review_comments: Security fixes (BOLA guard + atomic credit deduction + Meta 502 refund + daily LLM quota) are all covered by iter172/iter173 tests including test_thread_bola_other_tenant_404 and test_reply_meta_failure_not_500 — both pass.
Sender label is correctly derived from env WHATSAPP_PLATFORM_NUMBER and surfaces on GET /api/whatsapp-link/status as '+91 91802 61256'.

Deployment history panel is only reachable via Super Admin → All → 'Deployments' (not a top-level tab). Consider surfacing 'Credit Wallet' as its own quick tab too — it currently lives only inside 'Billing & Subscriptions' scroll section (works, but hidden).

rca of the issue: iter173 reservation flakes: reservations DB retains prior test runs → the deterministic 'tomorrow 8 pm' slot is already fully booked → Mira answers with 'fully booked' + alternatives. Fix in the test (rotate slot or delete guest's prior booking) rather than in product code.
